comment: Dr. Gussow is what every psych professor should be. Her lectures were super interesting and you could tell she was passionate about the topic. She made complex topics seem straightforward and made sure everyone understood before moving on. Exams were just as expected and if you do the study guide you should be set. She was very helpful during labs.

Dr. Gussow is a very caring and funny professor who makes lectures interesting. She is what all Psych professors should be. She is a kind grader who grades labs for completion and is not harsh on other assignments. Her exams are mostly multiple choice with 3/4 short response questions at the end. As long as you review the lectures, you will pass
